results.title: Spain break down Czechs as England outclass Croatia in Nations League
results.description: Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka both scored twice as England overwhelmed Croatia in Rijeka, with Kane taking his record tally for his country to 89 goals.

results.title: Student who shot Donald Trump sent strange key messages to strangers
results.description: The FBI discovered that Thomas Crooks, the author of the attack on Donald Trump, was communicating with strangers using strange codes.
